name: GB energy supply margins
value: No notice in force; EMN 8 Nov for 9 Nov
summary: NESO issued a precautionary Electricity Margin Notice for 9 Nov amid low wind; none in force as of 13 Nov
state: NESO issued a precautionary Electricity Margin Notice on the evening of 8 Nov for 06:00–11:00 on 9 Nov, forecasting a shortfall of about 1.4 GW against its required margin as wind output fell, and said there was no risk to supplies (BritBrief). That notice has lapsed, and no further Electricity Margin Notice, capacity market notice or Gas Margins Notice was found in force as of 13 Nov, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: A margin notice asks generators to make more power available and is not a warning of power cuts. Households need take no action; NESO and National Gas publish any further notices on their websites.
rubric_hit: Normal: no NESO or National Gas notice in force on 13 Nov; the 8 Nov EMN covered only 9 Nov morning

sources.title: BritBrief — UK power grid operator issues electricity supply warning for Monday as margin falls

why: When gas or electricity margins tighten, Britain risks price spikes and, at worst, controlled disconnections in winter.
drivers: Gas imports and storage, wind output, interconnectors, plant outages, cold weather.

rubric.alert: A Gas Deficit Warning, a high risk of demand control notice, or demand control used.
rubric.watch: NESO issues an Electricity Margin Notice or capacity market notice, or National Gas issues a Gas Margins Notice.
rubric.normal: NESO and National Gas report adequate margins; no notices issued.
